limitations: Current CLI supports snapshot collection/view/export, not automated restore or full machine backup.
--slim only excludes Claude prompt history and session summaries; Hermes memories/user profiles and other configuration still collected. Redaction is format/pattern based and not universally applied.
CLI diff compares file size/presence and inventory names, not content or version changes; scan --json still writes a progress line to stdout.
backup rescans and saves locally only after snapshot upload succeeds; icon export/upload is a separate subsequent step.
Current backup uses Bearer /api/snapshots and /api/icons. Webhook settings belong to legacy /ingest ingestion.
--dev switches login/config only, not upload API. OTTER_API_URL overrides uploads but not hardcoded login domains; snapshots/icons are shared between modes.
Vite defaults to the production workers.dev backend; environment files belong in packages/web. Ordinary Worker dev does not retarget this proxy.
Standalone local runner clears its isolated state on startup; L2 and manual runner share port17020; browser configs share27019 and may reuse existing server outside CI.
Worker dispatcher does not expose /v1 even though Wrangler and createApp retain related configuration; confirmed local /v1/live=404.
Snapshot API enforces email ownership; browser hostname search is disabled.
Current auth middleware rejects missing/invalid Access JWT unless a valid Bearer path or explicit local/test bypass applies; old CLAUDE prose says otherwise and is unchanged.
Release performs no D1 migrations or npm publish; site reachability check accepts HTTP200/401 rather than checking all application behavior.
npm 2.0.3 depends on the old @nocoo/cli-base name while source uses @nocoo/base-cli; inspected published commands and Hermes registry match the documented flow.
